Retrieve a GovernanceFrameworkVersion by its chain-assigned global ID with its nested documents (IDX-GF-QRY-1). Aligned with VPR MOD-GF-QRY-1. Exactly one of ecosystem_id (EGF) and corporation_id (CGF) is set. Rows indexed before the chain-id capture need a reindex to be reachable by ID.
